title: sdks: unify auth/retries & streaming ergonomics; parity fixes; v1.30.0
author: Ava Chen
description: Unifies auth/retries behavior and improves streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs, applies parity fixes and bumps SDK versions to v1.30.0. Motivation: teams observed inconsistent retry semantics across SDKs and awkward streaming APIs that made client-side consumption error-prone and fragile. Summary of changes: 1) Consolidate token refresh + retry middleware into a single, shared pattern with deterministic exponential backoff, jitter, and idempotency key propagation; 2) Introduce a consistent streaming interface for sync/async languages (Python iterator/async iterator, TS async iterable, Go channel iterator) with explicit cancelation, backpressure hooks, and graceful EOF handling; 3) Fix cross-SDK parity issues (header normalization, content-type handling for streaming SSE/chunked, and consistent error envelope shapes); 4) Bump SDK package versions to v1.30.0 and publish changelogs; 5) Update docs and examples to demonstrate streaming ergonomics and retry configuration. Checklist: [x] unit tests added/updated; [x] integration tests passing; [x] docs updated; [x] changelog updated; [x] e2e smoke on staging (manual) planned post-merge. Links: see cross-sdk test matrix in ENG-2145 and design thread in PM-432.

release_notes: v1.30.0: Unify auth token refresh and retry behavior across SDKs; introduce consistent streaming ergonomics and cancelation hooks.
Fixes: header normalization and error envelope parity across Python/TS/Go SDKs.
Documentation: new streaming guide and examples for each SDK.
Note: no breaking API changes for typical usage; advanced consumers using custom retry wrappers should review the new RetryPolicy semantics.
